title: CASCADE Against Jailbreaks: Combination Across Stages with Controlled Attack-Defense Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2609.21793v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Defenses against jailbreak attacks on Large Language Models (LLMs) operate at different pipeline stages, such as input modification or output guard, but it remains unclear which defenses to deploy at each stage and how to combine them. Prior empirical studies, fragmented by inconsistent attack-success-rate definitions and experimental settings, have evaluated defenses largely in isolation. Here we present the first systematic study, to our knowledge, of defense combinations both within and across pipeline stages, under a consistent threat model of direct, black-box, single-turn attacks. Our decision framework standardizes evaluation through a principled attack-success-rate formulation with controlled query budgets, together with explicit fairness rules. Across 19 attacks and 15 defenses, we find that no single defense is universally best, but well-chosen combinations achieve substantial safety with minimal utility degradation, yielding

translated_title: CASCADE对抗越狱攻击：基于可控攻防评估的跨阶段防御组合方法
translated_abstract: 针对大语言模型（LLM）越狱攻击的防御措施运行于不同的流水线阶段，例如输入修改或输出防护，但目前尚不清楚应在每个阶段部署哪些防御措施以及如何将它们组合。以往的经验研究因攻击成功率定义和实验设置不一致而较为零散，且大多孤立地评估各类防御措施。据我们所知，本文首次在一致的直接、黑盒、单轮攻击威胁模型下，系统性地研究了流水线阶段内以及跨阶段的防御组合。我们的决策框架通过基于原则的攻击成功率公式（并受控查询预算）以及明确的公平性规则来标准化评估。在19种攻击和15种防御的实验中，我们发现没有任何单一防御措施是普遍最优的，但精心选择的防御组合能够以最小的效用损失实现显著的安全提升。
tldr: 本文首次在统一的威胁模型与标准化攻防评估框架下，系统研究了LLM流水线阶段内及跨阶段的越狱防御组合，发现精心选择的防御组合能以最小的效用损失实现显著的安全提升。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic study of jailbreak defense combinations within and across LLM pipeline stages under a unified threat model and standardized evaluation framework, showing that well-chosen defense combinations achieve substantial safety gains with minimal utility degradation.
